name: Reveler of Song (Bell)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Bell form (plays the handbells).

traits.name: Compelled Contest
traits.summary: Can't refuse a musical contest: a Performance check with an instrument (Influence) sets the save DC; failing costs 20 Psychic and a Stun.
traits.text: The reveler can't turn down a contest of skill with Musical Instruments. As an Influence action, a creature can make a Charisma (Performance) check with a Musical Instrument; the reveler must succeed on a Charisma save with a DC equal to the check's total, or take 20 Psychic damage and be Stunned until the end of that creature's next turn.

traits.name: Dancing Step
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.
traits.text: Leaving an enemy's reach never provokes Opportunity Attacks from the reveler.

traits.name: Ensemble Form (Bell)
traits.summary: This is the Bell form: it plays the handbells.
traits.text: The reveler takes one form: Drone, Drum or Bell. The form sets some traits and actions and the instrument it plays (hurdy-gurdy, frame drum, handbells). This block is the Bell form.

actions.name: Instrumental Blast
actions.summary: +8, reach 5 ft or range 90 ft, 2d8+5 Thunder.
actions.text: A blast of thunderous music, up close or from afar: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Stunning Clangor (Bell Only)
actions.summary: One creature it sees within 60 ft: DC 16 Con save, 9d8 Thunder (half on a success) and Stunned until the end of its next turn on a failure.
actions.text: Constitution save, DC 16, one creature the reveler can see within 60 feet. Failure: 40 (9d8) Thunder damage, and the target is Stunned until the end of the reveler's next turn. Success: half damage only.

summary: A fiend who fights as a musician, blasting thunder from every direction, here with handbells whose clangor stuns one foe at range.
